printf '%s
' 'Commands:'; for c in ps pgrep lsof fuser; do command -v "$c" || true; done; printf '%s
' 'Process scan from /proc:'; for d in /proc/[0-9]*; do pid=${d##*/}; if [ -r "$d/cmdline" ]; then cmd=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "$d/cmdline" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *node*|*npm*|*nvm*|*yarn*|*pnpm*|*webpack*|*vite*|*next*|*tsc*|*esbuild*|*rollup*|*parcel*) printf '%s %s

' "$pid" "$f" "$target";; esac; done; done

printf '%s
' 'npm configuration:'; npm config get cache; npm config get prefix; npm cache verify 2>&1; printf '%s
' 'nvm files:'; if [ -s /root/.nvm/nvm.sh ]; then . /root/.nvm/nvm.sh; command -v nvm; nvm --version; nvm cache dir; nvm current; else printf '%s
' 'nvm.sh missing'; fi

printf '%s
' 'Cache files and allocated sizes:'; for p in /root/.nvm/.cache /tmp/node-compile-cache; do printf '
[%s]
' "$p"; if [ -d "$p" ]; then du -ah -x "$p" 2>/dev/null | sort -h; printf '%s
' 'file count:'; printf '%s
' "$(rg --files -uu "$p" 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"; fi; done; printf '
[npm cache candidates]
'; for p in /root/.npm /root/.npm/_cacache /root/.cache/npm; do [ -e "$p" ] && { stat -c '%n|%F|%s bytes|%y' "$p"; du -sh "$p"; }; done
